checkpoints.description: [1/2] Similar cache: radius-8 cached group tables, background Build groups worker, build API and UI polling, migration/tests; [2/2] gates, UI review and publish

impact_assessment.why: Radius-8 grouping is too slow at page load, so the groups must be precomputed and only read by the Similar tab
impact_assessment.benefits: Responsive Similar page at radius 8 for large libraries, with background progress and no automatic deletion
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new build endpoint and table cache; dependency: stdlib threads; concurrency: background writer under the database lock; state: format 13 and a rebuild that can be interrupted by shutdown
impact_assessment.mitigation: Keep the page read-only, compute outside the read lock and swap the cache in one savepoint, poll status, test migration/privacy/build, run 4/4 gates and Chromium review

impact_assessment.why: Stored GPS points already power the Places rail; a local world outline adds Immich's map view without network tiles
impact_assessment.benefits: A read-only global map for the household with zero tile/CDN dependency, using existing /api/outline data
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new map tab and SVG rendering; dependency: stdlib/server unchanged, browser SVG only; concurrency: read-only; state: no schema change

impact_assessment.mitigation: Validate every hash through selection.visible, keep filenames collision-safe, test JSON/XMP/ZIP and privacy, gate and review

[1/2] Harden HTTP tests against intermittent ConnectionAbortedError with a fresh socket per request and a dedicated keep-alive test; [2/2] repeat suite, gates and publish

impact_assessment.why: The HTTP suite intermittently aborts a reused keep-alive socket on Windows, making 4/4 gates flaky and obscuring real failures
impact_assessment.benefits: Reliable test evidence while still covering one explicit keep-alive exchange
impact_assessment.risks: contract: test harness only; dependency: none; concurrency: fresh sockets avoid stale shared state; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use a per-call connection plus Connection: close, add a keep-alive regression test, run the suite repeatedly and publish
